snippet.title: Losers of the Crossroads 0.7.4 - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Hello, We are a young dev team. Our first game - Losers Of The Crossroads or LotC.😀
Losers of the Crossroads - it's a survival game like Don't Starve Together, Terraria, Mnecraft, Waxweaver.
The main character, Bobby woke up in a strange world that is not at all like the real one. You need to survive: Chop trees, mine ores, get food and much more.
Here's the trailer for the game!🤩
And also, you can play LotC on our Itch.iо - https://threertusk.itch.io/losers-of-the-crossroads
